home.welcomeText: At Šaber we shape our love of wood into furniture made from solid timber and steam-bent beech. We combine the natural beauty of wood with careful craftsmanship, creating pieces that bring warmth, comfort and durability to your space. Every curve and every detail reflects our dedication to the craft.
home.aboutTitle: A craft passed down through generations
home.aboutText: Šaber is a family workshop specialising in solid wood and bentwood chairs. Every piece is made in our own workshop — from selecting and drying the timber, through steam bending, to hand sanding and finishing. We furnish restaurants, cafés and hotels, as well as homes that value lasting quality.
home.bistroText: The classic bentwood bistro chair, designed for the everyday demands of hospitality — light, stable and timeless.
products.title: Products

products.readyLead: Chairs currently in stock that can be delivered right away, with no production wait.
mat.title: Materials & finishes
mat.lead: Every chair is tailored to its space — choose the wood, colour, upholstery and finish.
mat.woodLead: We work exclusively with solid wood. Beech is the basis of our bentwood models — elastic, strong and it takes colour beautifully.
mat.beechD: Bent and solid — the basis of every model
mat.colorsLead: Stains highlight the natural grain, while opaque paints give a modern, even look. RAL colours available on request.
mat.uphLead: Hard-wearing fabrics for hospitality, natural and faux leather, and classic Vienna cane for bentwood models.
mat.finLead: The final coat protects the wood and defines how the chair looks and feels to the touch.
mat.f1d: A discreet, natural look. The most common choice for hospitality.
mat.f2d: A soft sheen that highlights the grain and is easy to maintain.
mat.f3d: The wood stays warm and alive to the touch; easy to renew.
mat.f4d: An odourless eco-friendly finish, resistant to moisture and alcohol.
mat.detText: Beech slats are steamed at high temperature, bent in moulds and dried until they hold their shape. Joints are made the traditional way — dowels and glue, reinforced where needed. Every chair is hand sanded between coats and inspected before delivery.

about.title: A love of wood, shaped by hand
about.storyTitle: From a small workshop to hundreds of furnished venues
about.story1: Šaber grew out of a family joinery workshop. What began as furniture for neighbours and friends has become the production of solid wood and bentwood chairs for hospitality venues across the region.
about.story2: We still work the same way today: we carefully select the wood, steam bend it, sand it by hand and finish every piece. We believe a good chair should last for decades — and only grow more beautiful with time.
about.p1d: We select beech timber and dry it to the ideal moisture content.
about.p2d: Slats are steamed and bent in moulds into their characteristic curves.
about.p3d: Parts are shaped, joined and sanded by hand.
about.p4d: Staining, lacquering and upholstery of your choice.
about.valText: Our chairs are engineered to withstand intensive use in restaurants and cafés. We produce runs from a few pieces to several hundred, with dimensions, colour and upholstery adapted to your interior.
